static_traits.name: Luo Jialin
static_traits.educational_background: Received ballet training from childhood, ballet study throughout life
static_traits.family_status: Family fully supportive,Mother is a ballet Dancer
static_traits.social_status: Has a family support system; worrying that Interpersonal relationships will suffer after Retired
static_traits.medical_history: without major physical illness history;without psychotherapy or counseling history
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude;clear expression, capable of self-Reflection, cooperating well with the counselor

basic_info.main_problem: Worrying about feeling bored and Loneliness after retiring from a dance career in 6 months. As retirement planning begins, this worry about boredom and Loneliness gradually intensifies; related feelings arise whenever thinking about post-retirement life (almost daily).
basic_info.core_demands: I have decided to seek counseling now because the Fear of boredom and Loneliness has begun interfering with my daily life and emotional health.
growth_experiences: Family-of-origin and developmental background:Mother is a ballet Dancer, family fully supports her dance path;Trained in ballet since childhood, dance became the core identity and center of life.

Major transitions and adaptation in youth: once moved to a different city to join a new dance troupe; initially very hard, but gradually adapted through wholehearted dedication to Work and actively befriending new colleagues, eventually falling in love with the new environment and building a sense of belonging.

core_beliefs: My identity and worth highly depend on dance
Without dance I will lose my sense of purpose and self

special_situations.event: Whenever thinking about post-retirement life (almost daily)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not dance, I will lose my identity and goals, and life will become empty and lonely
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to use hobbies and activities to distract attention
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: After Retired I will be very bored and lonely

special_situations.event: As the Retired date approaches and planning for retirement begins
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot find a replacement activity comparable to dance, my life will completely lose meaning
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Making stricter schedules, trying to find new community activities or volunteer services
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Apart from dance, nothing can give me the same fulfillment and sense of purpose

special_situations.event: Worrying that Interpersonal relationships will be affected after Retired
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If no longer in the dance troupe, my connections with others will disappear and I will be isolated
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Confides in family and seeks support, but at the same time feels it should be handled alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Relationships will worsen after Retired; everyone will drift away from me

special_situations.event: Trying new hobbies and activities but 'not feeling the same'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If new activities cannot bring the same feelings as dance, they are not worth continuing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Quickly gives up new hobbies and keeps looking for the next one
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: None of these compare to dancing; continuing is meaningless

core_conflict.wish: Longs to maintain the identity, value, and belonging conferred by dance
core_conflict.fear: Fearing losing self and purpose after Retired, falling into Loneliness and Meaninglessness
defense_goal: Reducing uncertainty and Anxiety by insisting on defining self as a Dancer and planning ahead

object_relations.self_representation: A self that loses direction once it leaves the stage
object_relations.object_representation: The post-Retired world/others may grow distant and no longer need me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others suggest making more use of family support, planning together, or relying on external resources
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to understand seeking help as weakness, believing one should bear and solve problems alone (transference: internalizing the external rule that one 'should be independent')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using statements like 'I should handle it myself', tone calm but slightly insistent, reducing acceptance of external support.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing the Unknown post-retirement life or being asked about specific feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Controlling uncertainty by emphasizing plans and steps, weakening direct emotional experience (transference: treating uncertainty as a threat)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in an organized, step-by-step manner, using as few emotional words as possible, maintaining a calm and objective tone.

manifestations: Worrying that losing dance means losing identity and purpose
Constantly worrying about future emptiness and lack of direction when planning Retired
Worrying that Interpersonal relationships will suffer after Retired
Fearing Reduced social interaction after leaving the dance troupe
outcomes: Increased negative predictions about the future
Increased avoidance of or giving up on new activities

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Expressing 'I think I should handle it myself'
Measures whether to accept others' support by the standard 'I should be independent'

exception_events.target_problem: When facing major life changes (like Retired), the client usually develops intense Anxiety and negative predictions about Loneliness and boredom while planning and thinking about the future, which in turn affects sleep and current Work performance.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In the experience of moving away from home as a young person to join a new dance troupe, the client was not trapped by Anxiety for long; instead, they devoted themselves fully to Work and actively befriended new colleagues, gradually adapting to the new environment and falling in love with it.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different approach—active investment and building interpersonal connections; different situation—gaining peer support and belonging in the new environment; hence a deviation point of successful adaptation this time.

positive_force: Having a stable and supportive family (Mother is also a ballet Dancer)
Having successfully adapted to major changes (moving to a new city and joining a new dance troupe)
Willing to seek professional help and starting to plan post-retirement activities
Has self-discipline and structured habits, willing to explore community activities and volunteering
negative_force: Negative thinking predicting the future (Fortune Telling)
Black-and-white cognition binds self-worth tightly to dance
Worries about Interpersonal relationships breaking heighten Loneliness Anticipation
Anxiety leads to Sleep affected, Declining motivation and focus

target_behavior.behavior: Prophecy-like worries about Retired and repeated negative thinking
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing that losing dance means losing identity and purpose, falling into Meaninglessness and Loneliness
target_behavior.function: Trying to gain a sense of control through advance worrying and constant thinking, avoiding uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep patterns affected, emotions and overall mood declined, motivation and focus for current dance performance reduced

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep affected (difficulty falling asleep or Declining sleep quality)
antecedent: Thinking about post-retirement life before sleep
Frequent daytime worrying leading to physiological arousal without Recovery
target_behavior.core_reason: Anxiety and negative predictions about Retired maintaining a state of high alertness
target_behavior.function: Maintaining alertness to cope with anticipated threats (avoiding the experience of uncertainty)
target_behavior.consequence: Daytime Low mood and fatigue, affecting daily life and Work performance
